name: Glow text whip swap
what: A big glowing word whips in from the right with a sideways motion blur that clears as it lands, holds for a moment, then is swapped for a second word that whips in from the left, overshoots the middle a little and settles sharp.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f10 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:10) the first word whips in from the right, sideways-blurred, with a small overshoot to the left at f8 (00:00:00:08); hold to f22 (00:00:00:22); f23-f26 (00:00:00:23-00:00:00:26) it shrinks away while the second word whips in from the left (f24-f27), blurred the other way; f28 (00:00:00:28) it overshoots the middle a little and clears to sharp by f30 (00:00:01:00); then it holds to the last frame f60 (00:00:02:00)
